'''Fierros''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], he was the commanding officer of [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] until the time Yuun was reassigned to [[Havoc Squad]].
